read_tier: Decision-Grade by sample size (n=40/arm); NOT sufficient for SP-1 section-14 production-promotion decision
this_run: Root-cause fix: rewrote FRQ02-C2 boundary table after diagnosing that a v1 rule (meant to stop over-credit) was applied too broadly and caused systematic under-credit. Did not add a new architecture arm.
headline_result: Plain SP-FAST (gpt-4o-mini, no escalation, cheapest/fastest arm) improved from 81.2% to 86.2% strict agreement from this single fix - a bigger jump than any architecture change tested in the prior 4 runs. Now within 1.3pp of the best escalation-style arm at ~1/16th the cost and ~half the latency.

c2_diagnostic.fixed_root_cause: v1's 'attributes randomness only to downstream effect' rule was applied too broadly, rejecting clear event-level claims like 'construction randomly killed plants' and 'randomly destroyed'

misattribution_audit.method: spaCy dependency parse; checks whether random/chance trigger words co-occur (sentence-scoped, negation-aware) with a destruction/survival-related lemma
misattribution_audit.standalone_accuracy_full_100: 66/100 (66%) - worse than any LLM arm alone, not a replacement classifier
misattribution_audit.deployed_role: disagreement-based audit, runs only on 'earned' verdicts for FRQ02-C2
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_testing: 'selection' lemma matched negated 'not because of natural selection', causing false earned on S028 - fixed via negation-scope detection
'event' lemma fixed 2 false alarms but caused a miss on S020 via unrelated content in a different sentence of the same response - reverted
misattribution_audit.not_yet_done: not wired into live grading harness as real-time gate; validated as offline post-hoc join against already-produced results

full_scale_validation_n100.scope_note: full FRQ02 corpus (100/100 available labeled responses), NOT multiple FRQs - no other summer-beta FRQ has a labeled corpus yet
full_scale_validation_n100.headline: Ties BM-Control exactly on accuracy at the largest available sample, ~2.7x faster, ~2.5x cheaper. C2-specific accuracy now beats control (79/100 vs 75/100).

parse_first_routing.method: runs misattribution parser BEFORE any model call for FRQ02-C2; routes to gpt-5.5-low (hard path) if parser finds trigger words with no qualifying attachment, else gpt-4o-mini (fast path)
parse_first_routing.bug_found_and_fixed: first attempt left existing confidence-based escalation (threshold 0.95) active on the fast path; 19/28 'fast' calls escalated to gpt-5.5 medium anyway, making it slower than C2Direct-Low instead of faster. Fixed by disabling escalation entirely on the fast path.
parse_first_routing.headline: Fixed parse-first ties C2Direct-Low on speed and C2 accuracy while cutting cost 61% (70% of C2 calls now run on gpt-4o-mini alone, no redundant escalation).
parse_first_routing.new_finding: Hard path (gpt-5.5, 12/40 routed cases) is only 50% accurate (6/12). Routing correctly identifies which cases are structurally hard, but the stronger model doesn't reliably resolve them - several overlap with previously-flagged likely corpus label inconsistencies (S014, S058, S070).
parse_first_routing.not_yet_tested: post-hoc misattribution audit has never been run end-to-end live (only offline-joined against existing results); combined parse-first + post-hoc-audit-on-both-paths design not built

bugs_found_and_fixed: escalateToMaxOutputTokens raised 200 -> 1000 across all 3 arms using the audit; S020 alone needs 493 reasoning tokens before gpt-5.5 medium can emit JSON, confirmed via direct probe
added bounded retry to the audit's escalation call, matching the existing primary-path pattern
fixed missing audit_escalation_retried default on the prefilter early-return path (schema-consistency drift)
misattribution_audit_live_run.audit_outcome: flagged 4/40 earned verdicts; escalation corrected 3/4 (S028, S068 fixed; S025 confirmed already-correct); S020 still wrong even after escalation with full reasoning budget
misattribution_audit_live_run.key_finding: S020 is now wrong across every configuration tested this entire session (BM-Control, every gpt-4o-mini variant, C2Direct medium, C2Direct-Low, parse-first hard path, SP-FAST-Gemini, and gpt-5.5 medium with no token constraint). No model/effort/routing combination has resolved it - points to boundary redesign or label adjudication, not another architecture variant.
misattribution_audit_live_run.latency_tail_diagnosis: p95/p100 are exactly the 4 audit-escalated responses (100% correlation), not noise. Direct, expected cost of the token-budget fix: giving the escalation call room to actually finish reasoning makes it slower, not just more reliable. Open design question, not yet decided: is this tradeoff acceptable as-is.
